label: Local service business (trades, cleaning, salon, tutoring, repair)
default_stack: Static website with a quote calculator and booking request form on GitHub Pages; bookings land as email or a form service's free tier; Google Business Profile listing completed by the owner.

questions.ask: Which services will you offer first, and which will you refuse?
questions.default: The two services the idea names, nothing else, until there are customers.

questions.ask: Which towns, postcodes or radius will you cover?
questions.default: A 15-mile radius around the city named in the idea.

questions.ask: How do you price today (hourly, per job, per square foot)?
questions.default: Per job, from a calculator built on local published rates the agent cites.

questions.ask: Which licences, insurance or certifications do you hold?
questions.default: None assumed; the agent lists what your trade and area require and adds it to the owner checklist.

questions.ask: How many jobs a week can you take?
questions.default: Five; the booking form closes when the week is full.

questions.ask: How many hours a week can you give the back office (calls, quotes, approvals)?
questions.default: Two hours a week, batched into one owner checklist.

owner_setup.what: Decide whether to trade as yourself or register a company.
owner_setup.why: Liability and tax; an agent cannot sign registration forms.

owner_setup.what: Buy the liability insurance your trade requires.
owner_setup.why: Needs a card and your identity; the agent lists quotes to compare.

owner_setup.what: Claim and verify a Google Business Profile with the text the agent drafted in marketing/.
owner_setup.why: Verification is by postcard or phone to you.

owner_setup.what: Open a separate business bank account.
owner_setup.why: Keeps the books clean; needs your ID.

owner_setup.what: Buy the domain the agent proposes in BUSINESS.md.
